entries.mem0ai/mem0: As the official Hermes Agent memory provider, this universal layer supports multi-level states for users, sessions, and agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This official provider utilizes a custom vector graph engine to achieve sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication with a 100% prompt-cache discount. It automates fact extraction and user profile maintenance while integrating directly with Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This AGPL-3.0 context database uses the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing across tiered L0, L1, and L2 loading layers. It is an official provider that demonstrates a 91% token reduction and significant task-completion gains on the LoCoMo10 benchmark.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain features a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges to provide synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis. It is designed for multi-user team environments through the use of scoped access controls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system focuses on long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over time. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents alongside dedicated Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables stateful agents through peer-centric modeling and background reasoning, serving as the upstream foundation for Hermes-specific wrappers. It can be deployed as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with support for Python and TypeScript.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages context trees as a git repository, offering versioning features like commit, branch, and merge. It employs a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based to ensure sub-100ms performance via a React-powered TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency system provides sub-millisecond memory operations for Hermes Agents using a single SQLite database. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE and includes a native Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context from persistent Qdrant storage and structured facts. The local infrastructure is built on Docker, Redis, and SQLite to maintain an auto-curated wiki for the agent.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive self-improving harness uses filesystem-first traces and reports to help agents succeed on complex tasks. It includes CLI tools for investigating tasks and supports multiple providers, including Pi and MCP clients.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management by storing messages in a SQLite-backed DAG that prevents data loss. It builds depth-aware summary nodes and provides tools for agents to search and expand compacted hierarchical material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This specialized wrapper enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent by self-hosting the Honcho backend. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer provides identity, memory, and secrets for agents, supporting portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients. It features source-backed recall and repairable memory, reporting 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer uses an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text. It supports Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code while providing local-first, zero-cost search.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that operates locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and vector search and integrates through MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including a Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall through why_retrieved tags. It includes built-in contradiction tracking, recency ranking, and owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and functions as an MCP-native server.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: A daemonless, long-term memory solution that stores data as inspectable Markdown files. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Codex and Claude Code.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens. It functions as an MCP-native server and integrates with the Perseus Vault for encrypted, persistent memory recall.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces tool-schema overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 using local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings from keyword selection.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database and BM25-first retrieval. It features an importance ranking system from 1-10 to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin supports immediate event deletion and provides a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer to manage memory.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session AI memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging via USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate agent payments.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest by default. It supports HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing for dense and exact-text recall.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides five native tools for searching and managing local artifacts. It includes a proactive router skill and supports automatic tool-OKF generation.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search method combining BM25, vector, and graph techniques.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories via semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A with file-and-line citations running over localhost.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes a subagent-driven-development methodology for task execution. It is essential for agents requiring a structured design refinement and brainstorming phase.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports while offering CLI support for coding agents. It enables agentic workflows through automation, design systems, and plugin features.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory via a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It supports Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients to manage ingested data.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills mapped across 29 security domains. These skills align with six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities to ensure diagram accuracy.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This tool automates skill evolution, deduplication, and quality improvement through an Agentic Evolver. It integrates with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs and provides a dashboard for inspecting session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides 12 metaskills that preserve state in a docs/ folder. These spec-conformant Agent Plugins are compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It includes a master router, connector skills, and protocols for delegated permissions and escrow.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1078 professional agent skills in plain markdown format. These skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code and can be exported for use in ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, and Codex.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation via slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set provides capabilities for YouTube transcript, search, channel, and playlist extraction. It uses the Agent Skills format and is compatible with Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It provides findings alongside a report detailing analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents using a three-level work model. It utilizes file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This toolkit provides integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository provides Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project offers API documentation and integration patterns for FLUX models, including prompting guides for text-to-image and image-to-image editing. It also provides six specialized FLUX 3 video skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files from repositories or documentation URLs. It ensures provenance through file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry provides a Python SkillDockClient and a CLI for installing reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running tasks with real-time progress and decision tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika serves as a workflow language for AI that provides static auditing via nika check and generates hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts. It supports local-first execution with any LLM using a single Rust binary.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill implements a 5-layer retrieval system—including hard triggers and semantic embeddings—to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token usage and provides graceful degradation if dependencies or embedding models are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to specific model families and preserves non-English prompts using langid or Unicode-range heuristics.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This skill performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews by using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It features a deterministic pre-scan layer and an MCP server to generate suppression rules for false positives.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for managing task state.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub provides community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation based on the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill uses a three-agent swarm to target code hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness. It includes a risk-tiered triage system and language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This tool generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to integrate user interests for search expansion.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are automatically updated on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It features an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android and provides configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers an automated Termux-based installer for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables Kubernetes deployment with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports both direct deployment and operator-ready CRD-based workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via Termux cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for Hermes Agent sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies regarding web search and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module facilitates reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration of workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps, and includes a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access for external AI client integrations.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This production package is distributed via GitHub Releases and can run as a TUI, Desktop app, or Gateway. It includes bundled CPython 3.12 and PortableGit and supports side-by-side execution with an installed Hermes instance.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM-based analysts, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical roles, to perform financial trading. It incorporates risk and portfolio management and supports local Ollama models alongside various LLM providers.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform manages multi-agent workflows and monitors spend across frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen. It provides a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API for task tracking and scheduling.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI, web dashboard, and CLI to manage diverse coding agents such as Claude Code and Gemini. It offers optional sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegating tasks between orchestrators and specialists. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management using Hermes Agent profiles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling and is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool creates a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It provides full structural extraction and cross-file resolution for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool and visualization dashboard tracks token usage and costs for multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes. It monitors usage through local data file analysis.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This project provides a self-contained HTML viewer for inspecting coding-agent API traffic from Hermes Agent and other clients. It redacts common authentication headers before recording traces.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, costs, and rate limits with multi-device synchronization. It reads Hermes Agent state directly alongside other CLIs on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to assist in building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous execution on VPS or laptops.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configuration.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and Solana-based payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows, as well as action undo and session snapshots.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, and Claude Agent SDK. It includes editor tooling for VS Code, Slack, and Telegram, plus a plugin for Claude Code to capture prompts and tool traces.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through preconfigured CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder local configurations and skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services to enable rapid deployment. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic, local checks on agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It supports JSON, YAML, Markdown, and Python files and utilizes HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool facilitates the transition from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping configs and credentials into YAML and JSON formats. It handles the migration of SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing modes to monitor and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant provides offline, local functionality with no API keys or accounts required. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, featuring adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a single interface to manage multiple agentic tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: An open-source cowork application that integrates multiple external agents like Hermes Agent and OpenClaw into one interface. It features built-in professional assistants for document creation and offers remote access via messaging apps and WebUI.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface designed for use on web browsers or mobile phones. It provides full parity with the Hermes CLI experience through a three-panel layout featuring chat and workspace file browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing and configuring Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard available via desktop, npm CLI, or Docker that manages 10 platform channels including Telegram and Discord. It includes visual workflow building, Kanban task tracking, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring an integrated memory browser, skills manager, and MCP catalog. It utilizes tmux-backed workers for Swarm Mode and includes a Monaco-based file browser and PTY terminal.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and other CLI agents. It supports delegation to sub-agents and provides native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair, alongside views for Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust that also supports macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime and supports Markdown and LaTeX rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects active browser contexts to local, cloud, or remote Hermes gateways. It features Hermes Assist for site-aware drafting and Hermes Web Alpha for session management.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents. It supports real-time streaming chat, file attachments, and management of agent tasks, skills, and workspace files.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, alongside a live workspace for monitoring diffs and code writes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and agent status panel. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS application that serves as a session browser and agent cockpit. It offers searchable history for ten supported agent sources and live per-session quota burn tracking with local-only data processing.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace is designed for Hermes Agent running on Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports managing profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with file attachments and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. The interface features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted AI assistance. It provides real-time log streaming, a file browser, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A dashboard focused on process monitoring and configuration. It provides real-time session activity and cost tracking, alongside read-only inspection of conversation histories and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client designed for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
